description.narrative: The project "Y-Glocal Citizen''?s main goal is to prepare young people to take local actions on global challenges, by training 24 young people from the three member countries of Y-Glocal in volunteering, acting on the Sustainable Development Goals and setting up small sustainable projects. The project aims to boost and motivate new as well as former volunteers within the partnership in a time of post-covid. The project will have three parts: A training, a camp followed up by local actions. Through lessons, sharing of experiences, workshops, actions on the ground, and support in the development of action plans, young people will be equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary to become more involved as volunteers within the YMCA movement and to contribute effectively to the sustainable development of their local communities and, with this strengthening the capacities of the various organisations.
